items.title: Near-miss: remit-to change from a spoofed Hoshi email
items.narrative: On Nov 11 we updated Hoshi's bank details from an emailed request. Before the Nov 14 payment run, our bank flagged that the new account's name didn't match Hoshi Optics K.K. A call to Hoshi's AR contact (number on file) confirmed they had sent nothing. Payment of ¥31.6M stopped; vendor master restored.
